data.narrative:
Theion is a Series A-stage climate and energy company founded by Ulrich Ehmes that has raised €25M+ to date. The valuation universe includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers in the Climate & Energy sector, with top private comparables including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression methodology is applicable to this valuation exercise. Using total capital raised (€25M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of €50M. Peer-median triangulation is not applicable; while eight same-sector peers exist, none satisfy the narrow filters required (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier). A median across all eight would introduce material distortion given stage and scale heterogeneity. Falling back to sector-wide medians is therefore declined.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of €42M (low) to €57M (high), with a median point of €50M. Material uncertainties surround (1) the degree to which typical 2.0x step-ups hold in the current climate-tech fundraising environment, and (2) the absence of tightly comparable peers at identical stage and capital efficiency, limiting cross-validation. A post-money valuation in the €48–52M range appears most defensible given available data.
